name: W&B Weave
description: Emit OpenClaw agent diagnostic events as OpenTelemetry spans to W&B Weave's Agents OTel endpoint (weave.* attributes, /agents/otel/v1/traces).

wandbApiKey.description: W&B API key. String literal (discouraged), { secretRef: { source, provider, id } } shape, or omit to read WANDB_API_KEY from env.

wandbBaseUrl.description: W&B install base URL — matches the Weave Python SDK's WANDB_BASE_URL env var. Default https://api.wandb.ai (cloud). For a dedicated install use your install hostname, e.g. https://acme.wandb.io. The plugin derives the trace-server URL per the Weave SDK rule (cloud -> https://trace.wandb.ai; dedicated -> <base>/traces) and appends /agents/otel/v1/traces. Falls back to WANDB_BASE_URL env var when omitted.

wfTraceServerUrl.description: Full trace-server URL override — matches the Weave Python SDK's WF_TRACE_SERVER_URL env var. Bypasses wandbBaseUrl derivation; plugin appends /agents/otel/v1/traces. Use for self-managed installs or proxy routing. Falls back to WF_TRACE_SERVER_URL env var when omitted.

wandbBaseUrl.label: W&B Base URL
wandbBaseUrl.help: Default https://api.wandb.ai. For dedicated set to your install host, e.g. https://acme.wandb.io.
